break_even.policy: For each prefix cardinality, emit the smallest eligible shared-prefix length as a threshold only when every longer tested length is also eligible. If eligible lengths are non-monotone, emit only their explicit tested-length allowlist. If none qualify, disable cache. Never interpolate beyond 1, 2, or 4 prefixes or beyond 16, 32, or 64 shared tokens.
break_even.rule: A tested point is cache-eligible only if exact outputs, cache mechanism, scheduler-dispersion, throughput, prompt-encode, p95, and CPU gates all pass.

contract.claim_boundary: E9c supports a cache-enablement policy only for the exact selected model, exact E7c native Arm service, sequential one-slot requests, tested prefix cardinalities, tested token lengths, and retained task sequence. It makes no energy, PMU, local-device, other-runtime, concurrency, fleet, or untested-length claim.
contract.hypothesis: The exact E7c service can retain exact selected outputs while prompt caching remains beneficial for at least one predeclared shared-prefix length under one, two, and four alternating-prefix workloads.
contract.negative_result_rule: Retain output drift, non-monotonicity, scheduler noise, or a no-break-even result without changing points, repetitions, gates, or policy logic.

prompt_construction.common_filler: Cache followed by the smallest non-negative count of single-token ' cache' repetitions that makes the four-variant tokenized longest common prefix equal the frozen target.
prompt_construction.instruction_suffix: Choose the correct option. Respond with only one uppercase letter: A, B, C, or D.

tokenizer_preflight.native_difference: The native /apply-template then /tokenize path uses add_special=false, so its token array omits the Transformers preflight BOS and needs one additional single-token filler repetition.

contract.scope: A bounded 3x3 native Arm64 prompt-cache generalization matrix on the exact E7c service; this is the first fallback after the retained E9b API blocker, not a broad server knob sweep.
contract.title: Prompt-cache alternating-prefix generalization boundary

validity.minimum_cache_on_tokens_per_request: the point's frozen shared-prefix token count
